chose: A concept comes back on the Leitner system (Leitner, 1972): five boxes rechecked after 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 weeks. An answer at relational or above that didn't come back lower moves it up a box. Anything else, a silence included, sends it to box 1. Decay is an answer below the level it stood at, the highest shown since it last decayed, so a concept that settles lower climbs again. Only a concept last shown known may have faded; one below relational is just due. The due list runs decayed, then faded, then last left unanswered, then not yet known, the longest overdue first, and leaves out a concept asked by a week whose essay isn't written yet when this run writes it, or when that week ended in the last two weeks.
options: the Leitner system, relational as the pass
SM-2's ease factors over the five SOLO levels
a fixed recheck every N weeks
